capabilities: Preview, visually edit, and save .html/.htm files in Preview, Edit, and Source modes
Render and edit html-v fenced code blocks and embedded HTML files in Markdown
Copy current HTML as Markdown or plain text
Aggregate checklist tasks and internal HTML links in a Tasks/Links side panel
Sanitize and sandbox previews with Safe, Sandbox, and Trusted modes
extras: Desktop-only. Detailed settings and installation guides live in separate docs files (docs/settings-guide.md, docs/local-install.md). Safe mode uses DOMPurify; preview interactions are restricted per trust mode.
problem: Obsidian has no built-in way to open, render, visually edit, or write back standalone HTML files, only inline HTML within Markdown.

relations.evidence: Use the built-in HTML V Tasks / Links side panel

summary: Desktop-only plugin that previews, visually edits, and saves .html/.htm files, html-v code blocks, and embedded HTML inside the vault.
